items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Dan Byas and all (unintelligible) be there

ctx.x: Right. And that's when after (unintelligible) he made that "Body and Soul" because he had the big band.

So we said, I said, Ben, we're going to have a little party for Hawk on his return back to the States. Dan Byas and all (unintelligible) be there and Ben come, and, well, I said, Lester going to be there. You know, I ought to punch that so and so in his mouth. I said, Ben, don't come down and break up the joint, said don't pay it no mind. So Lester came in here, and Lester's (unintelligible) that's going to play, down, lot of the fellows, different bands downtown, why, they'd come and they'd play. They cut…
